newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm sees more phone expenses in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm sees more phone expenses in Q4.

text.p: QUALCOMM Inc said it expects the transition to new phone models and the associated operating and development expenses to continue into the fourth fiscal quarter.

While operating expenses as a percentage of revenues continued to be lower than in fiscal year 1996, these expenses increased in terms of absolute dollars due to development of new phone models, the launch of a brand awareness and nationwide advertising campaign, and an increase in legal fees related to patent infringement litigation.
It expects results of these investments to come to fruition in the first half of fiscal year 1998.
